## Problem
What problem does this feature solve? Is it related to an existing frustration?

## Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives Considered
Other approaches you've thought about and why they're less suitable.

## Scope Check
- [ ] This is within OathMesh's scope (machine-call identity, not user auth)
- [ ] This does not conflict with the [NEVER list](../../oathmesh-prompt.md#part-6--explicit-never-list)
- [ ] I have checked existing [ADRs](../../docs/decisions/) for related decisions

## Additional Context
Any other context, diagrams, or references.
